title: Append a planning conversation message
responsibility: Saves a planning message with the design artifact or approved Change target it actually refers to.

inputs.name: planningMessage.context
inputs.description: The project planning API and repository context used to read the current plan and append the message.

inputs.name: planningMessage.draft
inputs.description: The message’s entity, thread, author, text, mode, provider/model and optional version, image hash and Change outcome. Null mode defaults to plan. User messages use Local reviewer; other authors use the provider name or Harness.

outputs.name: planningMessage
outputs.description: A promise for the saved display message. A matching image becomes an image reference; a notes-only function, service or config version can become a notes reference. Otherwise no artifact reference is added. Change messages retain the current approval target and default to requested status.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a Change message without a current plan approval or whose version differs from that approval. Planning read/write errors also propagate.
